title: Results of robot-assisted diaphragmatic repair in the treatment of symptomatic diaphragmatic paralysis
summary:
The operation examined is known as diaphragmatic plication. Diaphragmatic plication is a recognized treatment method for certain patients with diaphragmatic problems (diaphragmatic elevation) that lead to breathing difficulties. In this procedure, areas of the diaphragm are brought together so that the surface area of the diaphragm is reduced and its natural shape is restored.
Studies have shown that this treatment can improve breathing. Diaphragmatic plication reduces pressure on the lungs and allows the remaining respiratory muscles to work more effectively.
The results of this study will help to demonstrate the benefits of the operation and may provide new insights into the treatment. To this end, the results of lung function tests, a 6-minute walk test, and the answers from the questionnaire before and after diaphragmatic repair will be compared. It is expected that robotic technology will be able to effectively treat problems with diaphragmatic elevation.
A prospective study was chosen as the study design

interventions.name: The aim of this study is to examine the results of robot-assisted diaphragmatic repair in patients with diaphragmatic problems.

criteria:

symptomatic diaphragmatic paralysis
